scope: POSTHOC extra-information response-optimized oracle on all16 already-evaluated taper10 OOD systems. Starts from TRUE-medium Euclidean PCA projection and fits 800Hz broad-source TARGET response at 257 full-depth boundary profiles, not low-frequency context. It CANNOT be reported as a deployable method or an independent confirmation. Tests whether the frozen rank256 PCA subspace can represent target response better than Euclidean medium projection; finite 5-step local optimization is not a global subspace lower bound. Narrow2m source remains held out from oracle fit, but the oracle already has target-frequency broad truth.
